evidence.citation: “Stop before running any evaluation. First, clarify the skill’s first principles and whether the evaluation is judgment-based or truly conformance-based... Only after the user confirms that bar—and resolves whether the template is merely illustrative or an actual conformance requirement—may blind runs begin.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact requires pre-run clarification of the evaluation bar and template status, which establishes fixture validity and prevents spending runs against an undefined or misclassified criterion. This is necessary evaluation-control work under the supplied bar.
